reviews.title: From business to gaming, these are the monitors you need
reviews.comment: Amazing monitor for the price that looks amazing on my desk. Did need to change my docking station to hand two of these, but works great.  Use these for work and gaming with no complaints. Easy on eyes for spreadsheets and great graphics for the games.
reviews.author: Audra Karwoski

reviews.title: Worth it!
reviews.comment: I’ve had this monitor for a few months now it has helped with speed and eye strain, the quality is pretty good and if you have a PS5 most games at 120 FPS are capped lower than 4K. it doesn’t take much room at room and it’s very adjustable and can move in whichever way you want it to move. the brightness can be adjusted and so much more but keep in mind that if you turn the eye saver mode you can’t adjust the brightness, Very easy to set up and will definitely purchase another one for my set up soon!

reviews.title: Love Samsung products, they never disappoint.
reviews.comment:
Plug and play, changed the refresh rate, getting 270 fps. Easy to put together and light, I am disabled and was able to attach the stand. Daughter put on desk and zoom zoom zoom I can see again! Resolution is crisp, Very happy with my purchase. Would buy again.
Love the flat screen not curved and the size is more than enough for my old eyes. Looks great, no flickering, little bright but adjusted to my eyes via panel.
Samsung has always provided top notch quality, never disappointed with a Samsung.
reviews.author: Mahlady

reviews.title: A Remarkable Upgrade for Everyday Use and Visual Comfort
reviews.comment:
I purchased this Samsung monitor for my mother, who had been using the same 15-year-old display for years and was experiencing some eye strain. While her old monitor still functioned, she saw no reason to replace it. After some convincing, we set this one up, and now she wouldn't dream of going back. The difference in quality was immediately apparent.
Although this is marketed as a gaming monitor, its technical specifications are precisely what make it so exceptional for general use. The high refresh rate and crisp HD resolution deliver a remarkably clear, smooth, and vibrant picture that has made a world of difference for her. While we are still hoping it helps alleviate her eye issues over time, she genuinely appreciates the enhanced clarity—a benefit she didn't even know she was missing.
From a practical standpoint, the monitor is superbly designed. The stand is fully adjustable for height, swivel, and tilt, which allowed us to find the perfect ergonomic position for her. The single joystick control for the power and menu, located conveniently under the center of the screen, is intuitive and far easier to use than traditional button layouts.
Having owned Samsung TVs and monitors before, I trust their brand for its experience and reliable technology. This purchase has only reinforced that confidence. My mom may not be playing games, but she is thrilled with the crispness and quality of her new display. This monitor is an excellent value and a fantastic choice for anyone looking to improve their daily computing experience.
